text:
zara (marketing): Quick thread  cleaning up the battlecard and launch plan for the ops-focused webinar. Need defensible claims, routing rules, and 2 SDR openers. Can people quick-check?
derek (research): skimming. please avoid absolute 'beats' language. propose: 'shows lower median latency in our tests' + a one-line methods blurb. also recommend ranges for cost numbers.
maya (product): add a short tech blurb on fallback behavior: 'automatic fallback to quantized variants or regional replicas to help meet latency targets during surge.' emphasise no model replatforming.
alex (growth): routing + utm ideas: primary CTA -> sdr-ops; secondary -> ae-enterprise. UTMs: utm_campaign=ops_bench_q3. Proposed inbound rule (Console):
```json
{
  "source": "landing",
  "utm_campaign": "ops_bench_q3",
  "interest": "benchmarks",
  "route": "sdr-ops",
  "priority": 15
}
```
leila (sales): SDR openers (short):
- "Hey 1 saw you checked out our ops bench. Is p95 variability causing incidents for you?"
- "Quick q: would a reserved pool with predictable latency help your next pilot?"
Procurement line: "Reserved capacity + audit logs reduces procurement friction for regulated teams."
derek (research): tiny reproducibility snippet for the blog (short):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-x","input":"hello","max_tokens":64}'
```
zara (marketing): sweet. maya, can you sign off on the fallback sentence? legal-bot, can you confirm wording for public comparisons?
legal-bot: quick-check: recommend phrasing "shows lower median latency in our benchmarks" and avoid naming specific cloud vendors. OK to say "managed cloud endpoints" generically.
maya (product): approve fallback sentence with tiny edit: replace 'automatic' with 'policy-driven' to be accurate.
azex (growth): typo vouch: (alex) updated, linking tracking doc after this thread. will set GA experiments for two hero lines: A) "Predictable inference for production" B) "Lower unit cost at scale"
leila (sales): will upload SDR snippets to Outreach and add triage fields: pain_point = latency|cost|compliance; deploy_stage = dev|pilot|prod by EOD.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: battlecard + landing publish 2025-11-05T17:00:00Z; webinar registration opens 2025-10-28T09:00:00Z.
zara (marketing): thanks all. final checklist: (1) research adds methods blurb and ranges, (2) product approves final tech line, (3) growth sets UTMs + A/B, (4) sales uploads snippets. target close by 18:00 PT.
